literal_intervention_site_applicability: ordinary full-residual clean-to-corrupt patch installs the paired clean vector exactly at the intervention site, so paired state difference and full empirical-distribution difference are zero by construction; a finite half-sample EMD estimate may remain nonzero but has the same sampling baseline as natural-natural
ordinary_intervention: corrupt run with the complete clean resid_post center patched at the candidate site
natural_reference: paired clean run for the same sealed prompt

estimator.feature_standardization: separate featurewise sample mean and torch.std correction=1 with epsilon 1e-5

sampling.sample_size: all available cohort rows; the sealed cohort size must be even and no row may be dropped or truncated
sampling.seed_derivation: first 64 bits of sha256 over canonical [GREEN_V400_GRANT_SPLIT_V1, root_seed, protocol_id, phase, candidate_layer, cohort_site_row_ids_sha256]
sampling.split: one deterministic permutation; reference clean is first half, compared patched and its paired clean control are the same second-half prompts

contextual_control: clean final-position states versus unpatched-corrupt final-position states under the identical cohort split and estimator
analysis_role: nonprimary cohort diagnostic only; never broadcast to rows, never used for threshold fitting or row selection, and never counted as a GREEN win
